messages:
Ravi (CS): Quick capture from AtlasPoint onboarding: three repeated asks that bubbled up from their finance and platform teams — per-route cost breakdowns, a way to pin embeddings per route, and a one-page starter checklist with example prompts. They said the lack of per-route visibility is stalling their internal rollout and could impact renewal.

Ava (PM): Thanks Ravi. Any verbatim quotes or which routes they call out? need to size and prioritize.

Ravi (CS): Verbatim snippets from two calls: 
- "We need cost by endpoint so our product teams can be charged correctly. Right now it's a black box."
- "If embeddings spike we want to pin to a cheaper model for search routes."
They specifically mentioned `customer-inbox-summarize` and `kb-embeds-search`.

Sylvia (Product): Good capture. My initial triage: checklist + prompts = immediate low-effort win. Per-route CSV export = short-term stopgap. Full per-route cost UI + billing attribution = roadmap (bigger). Embedding-pin per-route = medium effort but clear ROI for customers who care about embedding spend.

Noah (Eng): For a stopgap we can add route_id to billing aggregation and an authenticated CSV endpoint. Estimate: 2 dev days to expose CSV (ETL + endpoint + auth). Embedding-pin needs a tiny metadata table + lookup in runtime, ~3 dev days. Full UI is multiple sprints due to dashboard/filters and billing integration. Example ad-hoc query that CS can use now:

```sql
SELECT route_id, DATE_TRUNC('day', ts) as day, SUM(cost_cents) as cost_cents
FROM billing_events
WHERE account_id='atlaspoint' AND ts >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY route_id, day;
```

Ravi (CS): I'll pull exact call excerpts and attach them to the ticket. Recommend shipping the checklist and sample prompts this week, CSV next week, embedding-pin as follow-up. I'll flag AtlasPoint as at-risk if no interim CSV within 10 business days.

Ava (PM): Action items: Ravi opens `cs:feedback` ticket with quotes + affected routes; Product drafts checklist; Eng scopes CSV/embedding-pin and adds estimates. I'll mark CSV as P0 quick-win for retention.

OpsBot: JIRA ticket CS-5028 created by Ravi (CS) — "AtlasPoint onboarding: per-route cost CSV + embed-pin + checklist" — https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/CS-5028

Noah (Eng): Adding CS-5028 to sprint buffer. Will post a sample CSV and PR link in this thread when ready.

Sylvia (Product): I'll post the checklist draft here for review by EOD.

Ravi (CS): Thanks team. I'll keep AtlasPoint updated with interim timeline and escalate renewal risk if needed. :thumbsup:
